title: The Body climbs to Netflix No. 1 with 86% viewership growth
excerpt:
The Body reaches 9.5 million views in its first full week.
Black Doves season two follows with 3.7 million views.
body_md:
The mystery series The Body has reached the top of Netflix's weekly English-language television chart during its first full week on the streaming service. The show registered 9.5 million views between November 16 and November 22, following its November 11, 2026 premiere.

That figure represents an increase of approximately 86 percent over the 5.1 million views recorded during its initial days of availability. There is an important distinction when interpreting the numbers: the premiere window covered fewer days than the subsequent full week. The percentage therefore describes an increase in reported totals, not necessarily the same rate of growth across two equally long measurement periods.

Created by Quinn Shephard, the young adult drama follows a group of girls at a Catholic school whose lives change after a dance-team initiation goes wrong on Halloween night in 2004. The girls begin experiencing prophetic visions, setting off a chain of events that leads to widespread anxiety and hysteria in their community. The premise brings together supernatural mystery, adolescent relationships and questions about collective belief.

The series has also generated controversy since its debut. A petition criticizing its treatment of Christianity circulated following the premiere. Although that discussion coincided with increasing viewership, the available figures cannot establish whether the controversy directly caused more people to watch. Audience interest may also reflect the appeal of the premise, promotion and recommendations between viewers.

The Body's lead over its television competitors was substantial. The second season of the espionage thriller Black Doves took second place with 3.7 million views, while its first season returned to the chart in sixth place with 2.1 million. The documentary series Taken: Natalee Holloway ranked fourth with 2.2 million views.

Meanwhile, the third season of Nobody Wants This placed eighth with 1.5 million views, bringing its cumulative total to 21.3 million since launch. Netflix's film offerings delivered higher individual totals, with the holiday romantic comedy Guarding Stars attracting 27.6 million views and becoming the platform's leading offering for the week.

The performance of The Body nevertheless establishes it as a notable new television release for Netflix. Its combination of period setting, mystery and supernatural elements has attracted considerable attention. The next few weekly charts will offer a better indication of whether that interest can be sustained beyond the initial release period. The current figures alone do not establish that the series will receive another season.
